subject: delta(client): WF refuse a reopen whose lane and intent rows are at different stages and narrow the README's missing-row refusal
note: A reopen whose lane and intent rows both name the retained transaction but are at different stages, one at broadcast-started and the other finished as withheld, now refuses outcome_unknown before any send. Such rows are left when only the lane's write that finishes a withheld broadcast fails; a reopen keeps rows at broadcast-started as they are, so it would have sent while the intent row still said withheld, and a readback before inclusion would have reported the transfer failed and freed the lane. Rows that agree are unchanged: both at broadcast-started are sent without being written again, and both finished as withheld are written at broadcast-started before the send. A readback still finishes a lane left at broadcast-started next to a withheld intent row as withheld, after which a reopen can send. The README's refusal list now names this case, and says exactly when a transaction with neither row is sent: when the history alone shows no possible transmission.
